name: TEK Electronics, LLC
old_description: Fast, Friendly, Local Support with Over 25 Years of Experience
about:
TEK Electronics, LLC was founded in 2001 and operates from Middletown, Delaware. The company serves the Delaware Valley region, covering Delaware, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides a range of information technology services aimed at small and mid-sized businesses. Its offerings include IT assessments, ongoing IT management, hardware and software procurement and support, video surveillance and security system installation, voice over IP (VoIP) services, preventative maintenance, and remote and on-site technical support. The company emphasizes full warranty service performed by in-house technicians and uses only genuine replacement parts.

TEK Electronics works with clients across several sectors, including healthcare and medical practices, manufacturing and industrial facilities, school districts, office buildings and commercial properties, high-rise and multi-family residential buildings, and police and fire departments. Its service area spans the tri-state region of Delaware, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania.

The company positions its differentiation on local, responsive support combined with enterprise-level experience. It highlights a proactive approach to reduce downtime, clear communication, fast resolution, and a no-pressure sales philosophy focused on honest advice.
